Indian weddings don't need marketing. They go VIRAL organically. 🤣

🇺🇸 USA Wedding
100 Invites → 68 Guests → 68 Gifts 🎁

🇮🇳 Indian Wedding
200 Invites → 3,753 Guests 😭
16 Gifts 🎁
...and somehow even the plates, glasses & cooking oil disappear. 😂

Networking? ❌
Indian Wedding? ✅

ROI = Return On Invitations. 😎
